reason: Removes quota rows whose daily, weekly and monthly limits are all NULL; a missing row represents unlimited access in both application versions.
risk: The DELETE locks matching rows and permanently removes their window usage counters, including soft-deleted unlimited rows. Any non-NULL limit, including zero, is preserved.
mitigation: Save a server-local custom-format backup of user_platform_quotas before applying pending migrations. The exact three-NULL predicate is covered by the migration test, and execution remains transactional. Historical billed usage in usage_logs is unaffected; restore quota rows from the backup if their otherwise unused counters are needed.
